notes:
Snapshot: payments infrastructure company looking to add LLM capabilities for merchant support chat, transaction reranking, and automated fraud alert summarization. High initial intent Q3.

Timeline (CRM notes, terse):
- 2024-07-02: inbound via website; Head of AI Ops (Marta Chen) reaches out. Discovery call with AE (Priya) and SE (Jordan).
- 2024-08-22: product intro + quick demo (hosted API + embeddings). Fireflies: ff_20240822_intro.
- 2024-09-05: POC started (embedding index + reranker for payments rules). SE led; observed good accuracy but request for regional residency.
- 2024-09-14: POC review; adoption slow due to engineering bandwidth. Fireflies: ff_20240914_poc_demo.
- 2024-10-09: Procurement asks for single vendor strategy across AI teams; mentions existing contracts with OpenAI across other business units.
- 2024-10-30: Security deep-dive. Customer wants private endpoint / VPC and EU data residency for EU merchants. Fireflies: ff_20241030_sec_call; drive doc: drive:/security/cedar_ridge/sec_questions_answers.xlsx.
- 2024-11-01: Internal reorg: primary champion (Marta) moved to another org; new sponsor less available.
- 2024-11-06: Procurement announces vendor selection for pilot: OpenAI direct API. Low friction, cross-team standardization cited.

Loss rationale (paraphrased from stakeholders):
- "We need to move fast and minimize infra work; we're standardizing on OpenAI for initial rollout."
- Preference for brand/visibility and a single vendor across analytics and product teams.
- Billing and contract simplicity: OpenAI existing enterprise relationships made legal/compliance path faster.
- Security: long-term requirement remains private endpoint, but for MVP they accepted a managed API to ship quickly.
- No internal champion after org move slowed our momentum; procurement used that pause to favor lowest-friction vendor.

What we proposed: staged approach (hosted pilot -> Dedicated -> Private for residency). Provided pricing scenarios, SLA commitments, and security materials (drive:/deals/cedar_ridge/proposal_v3.pdf). Offered KMS/HSM integration plan and assisted legal templates.

Why it failed: timing + procurement risk aversion + brand preference + internal churn. Pilot adoption low; budget freeze messaging in late Q4 pushed procurement to pick vendor with fastest path to sign.

Next administrative steps:
- Update CRM status to closed-lost (reason: selected_openai_direct_api).
- Complete win/loss doc; include notes for product on private endpoint interest and residency requirements.
- Add follow-up task: re-engage 2025-05 to present private deployment options once pilot completes.
